integrity: All universal statements follow from an exact integer Pythagorean reduction with a divisibility contradiction and an exhaustive classification of \(\Omega(n)\le2\). The finite checker is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: This theorem proves only the sharp minimum \(\Omega(n)\ge3\) and an integer-pair obstruction; it does not classify the complete three-prime-factor layer or determine infinitude or density.
title: A sharp three-factor obstruction for integral means of \(\varphi(n)\) and \(\sigma(n)\)
